rule: Omens are VERIFIED coincidences only — every entry needs sources and a verified date. They are a tie-breaker factor: shown on every report, allowed to lean a coin-flip call, NEVER allowed to move a model probability or flip a verdict. Applies to EVERY sport: teams holds team names for team sports, player/fighter names for tennis and UFC; each omen carries its sport.

omens.claim: Spain's 2026 squad carries exactly 8 Barcelona players — the 2010 title squad also had exactly 8 Barca players become champions (Valdes, Pique, Puyol, Busquets, Xavi, Iniesta, Pedro, Villa).
Shakira performs the official World Cup song in 2026 (Dai Dai, with Burna Boy) — the last World Cup with a Shakira official song was 2010 (Waka Waka), which Spain won.
2010 Spain failed to win its opener (0-1 Switzerland) then won the title; 2026 Spain's ONLY dropped points are its opener (0-0 Cape Verde, per WC cache) — same stumble-then-march shape.
2010 Spain conceded 2 goals in 7 games; 2026 Spain has conceded 1 through 7 (semi included, 2-0 vs France) — the same all-time-stingy run profile.
2026 is the 60th anniversary of 1966 — England's only World Cup title.
Argentina's only title on foreign soil came in North America (Mexico 1986), beating England on the way — 2026 is the World Cup's return to North America, 40 years on.
No nation has retained the World Cup since Brazil 1962 — Argentina are the defending 2022 champions, so 60+ years of history lean against the repeat.
Messi has never faced England in his entire career — this semifinal is the first time, and the first England-Argentina match of any kind in 21 years.
